title: TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. translated_title: TReVS：融合文本相关性与视觉显著性以实现高效视觉-语言模型Token剪枝
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型在视觉理解与推理方面表现出色，但由于视觉token数量庞大，往往带来高昂的推理成本。近期的视觉token剪枝方法越来越多地采用两阶段范式：首先在视觉编码器之后去除视觉冗余的token，然后在大语言模型（LLM）内部丢弃与文本查询无关的token。然而，由于第一阶段通常仅依赖视觉编码器的显著性信息，可能会过早地删除与查询相关的token，使后续的文本引导阶段失去关键的视觉证据。我们的实证分析表明，将查询引导引入第一阶段剪枝能够更好地保留任务相关证据，并且相比仅基于视觉显著性的剪枝方法能够持续提升性能。我们进一步发现，高方差的注意力头对文本查询更加敏感，并能产生更具判别性的文本到视觉（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TReVS方法，通过将文本查询相关性融入视觉token剪枝的第一阶段并与视觉显著性相结合，避免了查询相关token被过早删除，在降低视觉-语言模型推理成本的同时持续提升了任务性能。
